name: Direction
overview: Scripture reveals that God actively directs His people by speaking clearly, even if they sometimes fail to perceive His guidance (Job 33:14). The Lord lovingly leads believers along paths of righteousness and restores their souls, demonstrating His personal care (Psalms 23:3). He promises to instruct and counsel His followers, keeping watch over them to guide their steps (Psalms 32:8; 37:23). Trusting wholly in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding is essential, as His Word serves as a lamp illuminating the way forward (Psalms 119:105; Proverbs 3:5).
